scope: Current-file lookup SQL/file orchestration component using shared Store boundary; test-only missing-index publisher. No app route, durable publication, whole-service resource or performance acceptance.
original_authors_credit: Original Dispatcharr authors and contributors retain all application and algorithm credit.
physical_resource_scenarios: Real metadata index table lock: canceled waiter retains caller/admission/memory until actual PostgreSQL reply and private connection close; shutdown reports incomplete while blocked.
Final Bytes clones retain actual Vec capacity after parser credits/caller return; configured64KiB response guard explicitly rejects valid160KiB description.
fresh_clock_index_mutations: Actual SQL update/delete from separate connection occurs at injected clock before native fresh index read.
limitations: Six malformed stored index cases explicitly return Unsupported; their original exception classes/order are not claimed.
Source missing-EPG/no-source preconditions belong to Store metadata selection outside callback.
The component publisher records original dispatch calls only; it cannot authorize production Parsing responses.
Client memory credits do not prove a bound on PostgreSQL server expression working memory for arbitrarily large preexisting indexes.
Native limits and source-path support remain bounded; no full current-programme application acceptance.
owned_native_file_cleanup: One synthetic /tmp/owned-current-lookup-* fixture root removed after all tests/physical jobs completed.
